info.about: Spider-Man: Web of Shadows is a 2008 action-adventure video game based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man.
info.trivia: It was the only Spider-Man game developed by Shaba Games, and Treyarch's last time assisting on one before the licence passed to Beenox.
info.why: Activision's Marvel games, this one included, were delisted from every digital storefront on January 1, 2014, leaving the disc as the way to buy it.
